meta.tagline: The new headquarters for a global digital business
meta.description: One platform connecting apps, games, K-culture, and media channels across the world.

home.lead: Five apps, eight channels, and the next project that has no name yet. We gather scattered digital ventures into one headquarters and open it to the world.

plate.alt: Magpie and tiger — a clay reinterpretation of a Korean hojakdo painting
plate.title: Magpie and Tiger

home.statement: GLOBAL DIGITAL UNIVERSE is an independent digital studio building apps and content from Korea for a worldwide audience. Social, games, K-culture and media live under one worldview, while each service runs on its own and speaks the same brand language.
home.statementFootnote: Strategy, design, engineering and operations — handled end to end by one team.
home.servicesNote: Every app opens directly in the browser, with its own repository and no server to maintain.
home.gamesTitle: Casual games with characters that live
home.gamesNote: We extend the world of KOMI and MOMO into play.
home.mediaNote: Korean channels speak Korean; global channels speak the local language.
home.contactBody: We welcome partnerships, collaborations and press enquiries. The official contact channel will be announced here as soon as it opens.

about.title: A small team, a wide world
about.lead: GLOBAL DIGITAL UNIVERSE began as one person's twenty-year idea and grew into a digital business headquarters. Apps, writing and channels are gathered here under a single brand.

blocks.label: WHAT WE DO
blocks.title: From concept to operations
blocks.body: Product planning, brand design, web engineering, content production and channel operations are handled in-house. We ship directly and revise against real user response every week.

blocks.label: HOW WE BUILD
blocks.title: Free infrastructure, paid-grade craft
blocks.body: Every service starts on free infrastructure: zero server cost, domain attached in a later phase. Quality comes from design decisions, not from budget.

blocks.label: WHERE WE STAND
blocks.title: A brand that is not tied to one character
blocks.body: KOMI and MOMO are beloved characters, but they are not the whole brand. GLOBAL DIGITAL UNIVERSE is the vessel that lets new services keep being born.

principles: Build only what people actually use.
Design inside free limits, and check the limits first.
Keep the brand name and menus editable from the admin.
Never delete originals; keep every draft restorable.

apps.title: Five services
apps.lead: Each app lives in its own repository. This site introduces and links them; the data stays inside each app.
apps.note: ABI ships as an Android APK; the others open directly in the browser.

games.title: The world of KOMI and MOMO
games.lead: We extend our character IP into games. The first is playable today; two more are in production.

kCulture.title: Korean texture, in the world's languages
kCulture.lead: Dancheong, minhwa and myeongri — Korean materials translated into forms a global audience can read. No Chinese characters, only the reader's own language.

pillars.title: KOMI — Character
pillars.body: A long-haired chihuahua who loves Korea introduces K-beauty, K-food, K-golf and K-places.

pillars.title: MANSE — Reading
pillars.body: K-Sajoo reads saju and compatibility from real astronomical calendars, in fifteen languages.

pillars.title: PATTERN — Motif
pillars.body: The colours and patterns of dancheong and minhwa return as stickers, backdrops and goods.

media.title: Eight channels
media.lead: One piece of content is rewritten for each channel's language and grammar. Korea runs on blog, cafe and Threads; the world on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Xiaohongshu.

news.title: Studio notes
news.lead: A record of launches, channel operations and what comes next.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: For partnerships, collaborations and press. The official email address is being set up — until then, reach us through the channels below.
contact.note: An enquiry form opens in phase four, together with the Control Center inbox.
